description: Return record change events in sequence order. Use this to synchronize data after since_seq, with 0 for full history. Without since_seq, the response gives the newest page. next_since_seq supplies the continuation position. Use get_freshness instead for source import times, or get_record with as_of_seq for an earlier record.

entity_type.description: Only changes for this record type.

limit.description: 1 to 1000. Default 100. MCP: default 25, at most 50.

since_seq.description: Return events after this seq, or the newest page when omitted. Set 0 for full history.

name: get_changes
title: Get changes
